query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.general.grade_levels
query.sql:
select distinct grade_level
from students
where (:schoolid = '0' or schoolid = :schoolid)
order by grade_level

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.general.years
query.sql:
select yearid, abbreviation, name
from terms
where schoolid = :schoolid and isyearrec = 1
order by yearid

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.general.terms
query.sql:
select dcid, id, abbreviation, name, yearid, portion, firstday, lastday
from terms
where schoolid = :schoolid and yearid = :yearid
order by yearid, portion, firstday, lastday

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.general.courses
query.sql:
select distinct c.dcid, c.course_name, c.course_number
from courses c left outer join school_course hc on c.id = hc.courseid
where nvl(hc.status,0) = 1 and (:schoolid = '0' or hc.schoolid = :schoolid)
order by c.course_name, c.course_number

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.general.sections
query.sql:
select distinct e.dcid, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number
from sections e inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number inner join terms r on e.termid = r.id and e.schoolid = r.schoolid
where r.yearid = :yearid and (:schoolid = '0' or e.schoolid = :schoolid)
order by 3

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.general.students
query.sql:
select distinct s.dcid, s.lastfirst, s.student_number, s.id
from students s
where s.enroll_status in (0,-1) and (:schoolid = '0' or s.schoolid = :schoolid)
order by s.lastfirst

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.general.teachers
query.sql:
select distinct dcid, lastfirst, teachernumber
from teachers
where staffstatus in (1,4) and status = 1 and (:schoolid = '0' or schoolid = :schoolid)
order by lastfirst

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.general.teachers.mysettings
query.sql:
select schoolstaffdcid, excluded, room, onlineurl
from u_schoolstaff_ptc5
where schoolstaffdcid = :schoolstaffdcid

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.general.contactswithdataaccess
query.sql:
select distinct p.id, p.firstname, p.middlename, p.lastname
from guardianstudent gs inner join guardianpersonassoc gpa on gs.guardianid = gpa.guardianid inner join person p on gpa.personid = p.id
order by p.lastname, p.firstname, p.middlename
